caption:
Your Google Business Profile has dead space.

Right next to your reviews sits one of the most visible spots on the local panel: Google Posts.

Most service-business profiles leave it blank for months. That blank space reads as closed, even when you're booked solid.

This week, post three things: a current job photo, your open appointment slots, and a recent five-star review. Ten minutes, zero ad spend.

Want this running as a system instead of a task you forget?

DM SCALE

#LocalSEO #GoogleBusinessProfile #HomeServices #ContractorMarketing #ServiceBusinessGrowth
rationale: GBP Posts occupy prime, high-visibility real estate next to reviews, yet most service profiles leave it blank for months. Framing this as an audit insight readers can verify on their own profile (instead of an unverifiable 'recent algorithm change') keeps the claim honest while still delivering a concrete, repeatable weekly action list.
